fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (000660.KS) target price was revised downward 36% from KRW 1.65 million to KRW 1.05 million, with BNK Securities warning of sharp memory price declines in Q2–Q3 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix share price has fallen 62.7% from its June high of KRW 2.987 million, with channel inventory adjustment imminent due to oversupply (supply increase of 38% against demand increase of 24% in 2026).
